Worker 提供 `double` 后，兼容的页面调用可取得 `42`。应用仍负责 Worker 地址、创建、部署和最终 terminate；这些示例做公开 dist 类型检查，不代替跨 realm 运行验证。
公共选项包括 `name`、`namespace`、`expose`、`connect: { timeoutMs }` 与完整业务 `features`。SharedWorker/ServiceWorker 两种来源互斥。根入口只导出这些工厂、对应选项类型以及 `RpcBrowserErrorCode`、`RPC_BROWSER_ERROR_SOURCE`。
推荐每个 Host 只安装一种传输，而非混用多种媒介；多端口或多参与者仍可属于同一种传输。确需混装时明确 namespace、路由与权限，不能把异构媒体当作同质成员池。

blocks.text: English · 包概览 · 统一调用规则
应用取得真实原生资源，每个 Host 通常选择一种传输。根对象管理身份、provider 与关闭；调用进入对应 namespace。以下完整模块按公开 dist 类型检查，不把静态通过当作真实 realm、认证或整体迁移验收。
Worker 端模块见 README，使用 Worker 全局类型。`host.worker` 是默认调用入口；`namespace` 可改名。Host 关闭不会调用 `worker.terminate()`，应用最终终止自己创建的 Worker。Node/Bun/Deno 原生线程使用 thread plugin，不使用这个浏览器资源边界。
对端指向本页面并提供 `title`。目标 Window 与本地 receiver 分别指定，origin 必须非空；通配符另需显式 `allowUnsafeTargetOrigin: true`。校验真实 source，不为被拒绝的来源读取业务载荷；自报身份不能绕过原生来源校验。
页面借用 `sharedWorker.port`，Worker 端选择 `sharedWorkerPlugin({ listen: self })`。两种来源互斥。listener 从真实 connect 事件取得每个端口，分别建会话；本地 Host 关闭不关闭借入端口或 terminate 共享 Worker。
调用者最终先 `await host.close()`，再按自身归属关闭 channel。发现/握手决定当前 RPC 参与者集合；原生广播不等于接纳所有消息为业务。`host.broadcastChannel.request` 使用当前集合，`send` 指定一个当前对端；空集合和重连 downtime 不能解释为业务完成。该原生 API 没有 transfer list。

`serviceWorker` 是发送目标，`receiver` 是本地订阅面，页面默认使用 `navigator.serviceWorker`。Worker 端选择 `serviceWorkerPlugin({ clients: self })`，按真实事件 source.id 通过 `clients.get` 解析原生 Client。插件不替应用注册、更新或 unregister Worker。
应用先完成协商并打开频道。要求 `ordered === true`、`maxRetransmits === null`、`maxPacketLifeTime === null`；插件不等待 WebRTC signaling，不接受不可靠或部分可靠配置。Host 只拥有自己的 RPC 订阅，不替应用关闭借入 channel。该路径使用 JSON 文本，不提供 native transfer。
插件等待借入 session 的 ready，然后创建一个可靠双向 stream。对端必须实现 `migaia.rpc/2` 的相同字节载体；普通 HTTP handler、任意 JSON 文本或 datagram 不是这个协议。Host 释放自身 reader/writer 和锁，不调用借入 session.close；不支持 native backing transfer。

调用者负责关闭返回的 Host。`timeout`/`retry` 是传输选择的完整业务 feature，放在该工厂的 `features`。probe/schema/auth/chunk/batch/typegen 是实际 host 介入插件，入口是 `@migaia/rpc-host/plugins/*`，启动前安装。`connect.timeoutMs` 只约束握手；业务 `timeoutMs` 与 `signal` 约束调用，不能把取消当成远端从未执行。
`outcome` 等可选扩展需要相应实际 plugin；完整自动 claim、身份 scope 和跨重连重放仍有未闭合项。不要配置根 Host 的旧策略字段、部署 assembler、手工 profile/ACK 或强制转换不支持的选项。
`rpc-contract` 提供纯协议/能力类型/错误契约，Host 管理调用与会话，Browser 管理原生来源和 I/O；业务 schema 交给 `/plugins/schema`。自定义载体作者使用 `@migaia/rpc-host/sdk` 的 canonical carrier，不再创建第二个 Host 或并行 codec。
原生 origin/source 校验不等于 auth verifier/principal/session 已全部接通。Host-close/drain、重启 downtime 与部分 observer 诊断兼容性仍有保留差异；本指南不承诺对应旧行为均已闭合。多种 transport 混装通常增加路由和权限歧义，优先独立 Host。
处理 `rpc.transport.browser` 与通用 RPC 错误时保留原生类型、`source/code/cause/errors` 和 stack。不要重建错误以丢弃原因，也不要只根据一次发送成功推断业务执行结果。应用最终释放其 Worker、端口、channel、session；Host 只释放自身资源。

Compile the separate `worker.ts` with Worker globals, without casting a page Window to Worker:

After the Worker provides `double`, the compatible page call can receive `42`. Applications own the address, creation, deployment and eventual termination. These examples receive public-dist typechecking, not cross-realm runtime acceptance.

Common options include `name`, `namespace`, `expose`, `connect: { timeoutMs }` and complete business `features`. SharedWorker/ServiceWorker source alternatives are exclusive. Root exports are these factories, their option types, `RpcBrowserErrorCode` and `RPC_BROWSER_ERROR_SOURCE`.

Prefer one transport kind per Host rather than mixed media. Several ports or participants may belong to that one kind. If mixing is necessary, define namespaces, routing and permissions explicitly; heterogeneous media are not a homogeneous member pool.

The root owns `self/provide/close`; actual namespaces such as `host.worker` or `host.window` expose `request/notify/stream/group`. `send(nameOrId, method, payload)` selects one current direct peer. Untargeted calls use that namespace's current direct set. Extensions such as `outcome` require their corresponding plugin.

Window binds actual `event.source` and an explicit origin; `'*'` also needs `allowUnsafeTargetOrigin: true`. ServiceWorker admission uses native sources and Client lookup, never a client ID claimed in payload. BroadcastChannel names are not peer identities; discovery and protocol handshake are still required.

Host closure withdraws its subscriptions/sessions without terminating borrowed Workers, MessagePorts, BroadcastChannels, RTCDataChannels or WebTransport sessions. WebTransport owns only its created reliable bidirectional stream, reader/writer and locks; it uses no datagrams. Applications release their own native objects.

The only profile is `migaia.rpc/2`. `@migaia/rpc-contract/protocol` provides pure protocol data/admission, `/interfaces` capability types, and `/errors` plus `/error-code` error contracts. Contract performs no business schema execution, I/O or policy. Custom carriers use canonical carriers from `@migaia/rpc-host/sdk`. Actual `/plugins/*` provide business validation and other intervention, rather than hidden transport switches.

Native structured clone and explicit ownership transfer are separate capabilities. BroadcastChannel, RTC and WebTransport do not expose the native transfer required by these plugins. Window/Worker transfer still depends on actual media and installed policies.

Native source filtering does not establish an authenticated principal or session/scope across reconnects. Automatic auth/source freshness, parts of outcome/idempotency and observer diagnostic compatibility remain unresolved. Neither a channel name nor a native source automatically supplies those guarantees. Generic Host close/drain and restart downtime differences are not browser guarantees either.

Failures may originate from `rpc.transport.browser` or shared RPC owners. Retain `source/code/cause/errors` and native stacks; text or one code alone does not establish execution outcome. Full migration acceptance remains pending. See the usage guide.
中文 · Overview · Shared call rules

Applications supply actual native resources and normally select one transport per Host. The root owns identity, providers and closure; calls use the corresponding namespace. These complete modules are typechecked against public dist, not proof of native realms, authentication or full migration acceptance.

See README for the Worker module with Worker globals. Calls use `host.worker` by default; `namespace` can rename it. Host close never calls worker.terminate; the creator eventually terminates the native Worker. Native Node/Bun/Deno threads use the thread plugin rather than this browser resource boundary.

The other side targets this page and provides `title`. Configure target Window separately from the local receiver. Origin is required; a wildcard additionally requires `allowUnsafeTargetOrigin: true`. Actual source filtering does not read a rejected source's business payload; a claimed identity cannot bypass it.

A page borrows sharedWorker.port; the Worker uses `sharedWorkerPlugin({ listen: self })`. These sources are exclusive. Native connect events supply each port for its own session. Host closure does not close borrowed ports or terminate the shared Worker.

The caller eventually awaits host.close, then closes its own channel. Discovery/handshake determine RPC membership; native broadcasting does not admit every message as business. `host.broadcastChannel.request` uses the current set and `send` selects a direct peer. Neither an empty set nor reconnect downtime establishes business completion. The native API has no transfer list.

`serviceWorker` is the send target; `receiver` owns local subscription, defaulting to navigator.serviceWorker on a page. A Worker uses `serviceWorkerPlugin({ clients: self })`, resolving actual event source.id through clients.get. The plugin does not register, update or unregister the Worker.

The application completes signaling and opens the channel first. Require ordered true and null maxRetransmits/maxPacketLifeTime. The plugin neither waits for WebRTC signaling nor accepts unreliable/partially reliable settings. Host owns only its RPC subscriptions and does not close the borrowed channel. This path uses JSON text without native transfer.

The plugin awaits the borrowed session's ready and creates one reliable bidirectional stream. The peer must implement the matching `migaia.rpc/2` byte carrier; an HTTP handler, arbitrary JSON text or datagrams are not that protocol. Host releases its reader/writer and locks without calling the borrowed session.close. Native backing transfer is unsupported.

The caller closes the returned Host. Timeout/retry are complete transport-selected business features in that factory's `features`. Probe/schema/auth/chunk/batch/typegen are actual host intervention plugins under `@migaia/rpc-host/plugins/*`, installed before startup. `connect.timeoutMs` bounds handshake only; per-call timeoutMs and signal concern business work. Cancellation does not prove remote non-execution.

Optional extensions such as outcome require their actual plugin. Automatic claim, identity scope and replay across reconnects remain incomplete. Do not restore root Host policy fields, deployment assemblers, manual profile/ACKs or casts of unsupported options.

Contract owns pure protocol/capability types/error contracts, Host owns calls/sessions, and Browser owns native sources/I/O. `/plugins/schema` performs business validation. Custom carrier authors use canonical carriers from `@migaia/rpc-host/sdk`, without another Host or codec.

Native origin/source checks do not establish completed auth verification/principal/session wiring. Host close/drain, restart downtime and parts of observer diagnostic compatibility retain known differences; this guide does not claim they are closed. Mixing transports usually adds routing/permission ambiguity; prefer separate Hosts.

Retain native types, `source/code/cause/errors` and stacks for browser and shared RPC errors. Do not rebuild errors to discard causes or infer business completion from successful sending. Applications release their Workers, ports, channels and sessions; Host releases only its own resources.
